name: 透
text:
メイク薄いよって言われたんだよね
──お母さんが言うなって感じだけど
trans:
They told me I was barely wearing any makeup.
──Honestly, it felt like something my mom would say.

name: 透
text:
一応、ビジュアルレッスン入れたいんだけど
一週間後どうかな
trans:
Just in case, I'd like to take visual lessons next 
week. If you're fine with that.

name: 透
text:
あ、いいの？
ふふっ、ありがと

name: 透
text:
あ、うん。わかってたよ
……ごめんね、急に
trans:
Ah, okay. Got it.
...Sorry for asking out of nowhere.
